# Moss rename (#1444) residue guard allowlist.
#
# Read by scripts/check-jarv-allowlist.ts. Every "jarv"/"Jarv"/"JARV" occurrence in the
# tree must be covered by a line below or the check fails. Seeded from the FROZEN set in
# docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-05-moss-rename-design.md §2.3 and §8 — NOT from a dump
# of current occurrences. Anything not listed here is expected to eventually be renamed;
# adding a line here is a deliberate claim that it never will be (or not yet).
#
# Two pattern kinds, one per line:
#   path:<glob>       matches the whole file — everything in it is exempt.
#                      `**` matches across path segments, `*` matches within one.
#   content:<string>  matches anywhere it appears (case-insensitive substring), in any
#                      file not otherwise covered.
#
# NOT wired into `pnpm verify:foundation` yet — most of the tree hasn't been renamed
# because tier D (roles/DB/tables) and tier E (images/URLs) of #1444 haven't landed.
# Run standalone: `node scripts/check-jarv-allowlist.ts`.

# --- Dated / historical documentation (spec §8: "dated documents under plans/, specs/,
# coordination/, audits/, releases/") ---------------------------------------------------
path:docs/superpowers/plans/**
path:docs/superpowers/specs/**
path:docs/superpowers/handoffs/**
path:docs/superpowers/research/**
path:docs/superpowers/reviews/**
path:docs/superpowers/spikes/**
path:docs/coordination/**
path:docs/audits/**
path:docs/audit/**
path:docs/architecture/**
path:docs/archive/**
path:docs/evidence/**
path:docs/reviews/**
path:docs/research/**
path:docs/brainstorms/**

# --- Pre-rename migrations and other hash-checked / immutable SQL ("Never edit an
# applied migration" — packages/db/src/migrations/sql-runner.ts checksums the whole
# file, so a "jarv" reference inside one of these is permanently frozen by construction,
# not by choice) ---------------------------------------------------------------------
path:infra/postgres/migrations/**
path:infra/postgres/bootstrap/**
path:infra/postgres/grants/**
path:packages/*/sql/**
path:spikes/**

# --- Installed host identity (spec §4.8: unit names and ~/Jarv1s checkout path stay
# frozen; separate follow-up to rename) ------------------------------------------------
path:infra/systemd/**
content:~/Jarv1s

# --- This PR's own files, which legitimately retain "jarv" content ---------------------
path:.github/jarv-allowlist.txt
path:scripts/check-jarv-allowlist.ts
path:tests/unit/check-jarv-allowlist.test.ts
path:scripts/backup-full.sh
path:scripts/smoke-compose.ts
path:tests/unit/prod-compose-plan.test.ts

# --- Persisted-in-the-database identifiers (spec §2.3: renaming needs a dual-read plus
# a data migration or restage — separate, later work) -----------------------------------
content:jarvis.goals
content:jarvis.commitments
content:jarvis-emotion-v1
content:actor_kind='jarvis'
content:actor_kind = 'jarvis'
content:jarvis_mod_

# --- External artifact contract (spec §2.3: every published external module ships
# these; renaming invalidates all of them at once) ---------------------------------------
content:jarvis.module.json
content:compatibility.jarv1s

# --- Wire format the model and the permission hook match on (spec §2.3) ----------------
content:mcp__jarvis__

# --- Cross-version coordination — advisory lock strings (spec §2.3: renaming one lets
# an old and a new binary both believe they hold it during a mixed-version window) ------
content:jarv1s:migrations

content:jarv1s:last-active-admin
content:jarv1s:module-reconcile

# --- Infrastructure identity (spec §5: docker volume names and the jarv1s-prod compose
# project name are internal and stay unchanged) ------------------------------------------
content:jarv1s-prod
content:jarv1s-postgres-data

content:jarv1s-cli-tools

content:jarv1s-modules

# --- Runtime role names (#1444 scope change: the four Postgres roles are no longer
# being renamed — renaming them required a pg_dump schema baseline to keep fresh installs
# working once 140 grants across 18 hash-frozen migrations named the roles literally, and
# that baseline was the single most fragile, highest-risk artifact in the plan for a
# cosmetic gain (role names are visible only in `psql \du`, never to a user, log, or API).
# Frozen indefinitely; see #1444.) --------------------------------------------------------
content:jarvis_migration_owner
content:jarvis_app_runtime
content:jarvis_worker_runtime
content:jarvis_auth_runtime
